toegepas.voor: Jy roep 'n grootmens en jy koel die brandwond op dieselfde tyd
toegepas.na: Jy roep 'n grootmens, en jy koel die brandwond terselfdertyd
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Op dieselfde tyd' calques 'at the same time' (Afrikaans: 'terselfdertyd'), and AWS requires a comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: 'op dieselfde tyd' calques 'at the same time', and the AWS clause comma before 'en' is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans form and the instruction (call an adult and cool the burn at once) keeps exactly its meaning and order.

toegepas.voor: Toe het sy nie gestaan en wag nie
toegepas.na: Toe het sy nie staan en wag nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'het' the 'staan en' construction takes the bare form, as the lesson itself does with 'het sit en lees'; 'gestaan en wag' mixes the two forms.
toegepas.fout: 'het nie gestaan en wag nie' mixes the participle with the bare-form 'staan en' construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: After 'het' the construction takes the bare form 'staan en wag', as the lesson already does with 'het sit en lees'.

toegepas.voor: Die water bly nou twintig minute lank aan en ek hou die tyd
toegepas.na: Die water bly nou twintig minute lank loop, en ek hou die tyd dop
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die water bly aan' and 'ek hou die tyd' are English calques ('stays on', 'keep time'); 'bly loop' matches the lesson's later wording, and the clause comma follows AWS.
toegepas.fout: 'Die water bly aan' and 'ek hou die tyd' are English calques and read stiffly in dialogue.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bly loop' and 'hou die tyd dop' are the natural expressions, match the lesson's later 'het bly loop', keep the twenty minutes, and the clause comma follows AWS.

toegepas.voor: Die kraan het bly loop en die res
toegepas.na: Die kraan het bly loop, en die res
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die kraan het bly loop' and 'die res van Sipho het warm gebly' are two full clauses, so AWS requires the comma.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Ná' with the accent marks 'after' and avoids reading it as the preposition 'na' (to).
toegepas.fout: 'Na' meaning 'after' sits among several prepositional 'na' (na die horlosie, na Sipho se arm) without the distinguishing accent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ná' marks the time sense, as the lesson's own protected wording ('ná die koeling') does, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Ná' with the accent marks 'after', consistent with the earlier time phrase.
toegepas.fout: Same as change 8: 'Na' meaning 'after' without the accent.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause stops two verbs running together and helps a Grade 6 reader.
toegepas.fout: The verbs 'het' and 'vertel' collide after the embedded relative clause, which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS recommends the comma where an embedded clause ends against the main verb, and it helps a Grade 6 reader.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Fingers are 'opgesteek' in Afrikaans; 'opgehou' usually reads as 'stopped'.
toegepas.fout: 'vingers opgehou' reads first as 'stopped' and is not the fixed expression.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans holds up fingers with 'opsteek', so 'opgesteek' is clearly better with the same meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: With 'het', the standard order puts the object before 'gaan' plus the infinitive.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'buite gaan wasgoed ophang' is accepted, natural Afrikaans in a story; the proposed order is only a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: net die brandwond moet koel word
laat_vaar.na: net die brandwond moet afgekoel word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Koel word' means 'become cool'; the passive 'be cooled' needs the participle 'afgekoel word'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'net die brandwond moet koel word' is grammatical and clear (only the burn must become cool); the passive is not clearly better.

laat_vaar.voor: om sy skouers en sy lyf toegedraai
laat_vaar.na: om sy skouers en sy lyf gedraai
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: With 'om' the natural verb is 'draai' (as the lesson says of the plastic later); 'toegedraai' doubles the idea of wrapping.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: ''n kombers om iemand toedraai' is a normal Afrikaans expression; dropping 'toe' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Die middag' is vague in a past-tense story; 'Daardie middag' clearly points to the afternoon of that same day.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die middag' is the usual Afrikaans way to say 'that afternoon' in a narrative; the proposal is only different.
